Atthabhūtaṁ.g: “buddhaṁ paccakkhāmī’ti vadati viññāpeti, evampi bhikkhave dubbalyāvikammañceva hoti, sikkhā ca paccakkhātā”ti-ādinā1 vuttehi yehi vacanehi sikkhāpaccakkhānañceva hoti dubbalyāvikammañca, taṁ “buddhaṁ paccakkhāmī”ti-ādikaṁ atthabhūtaṁ dubbalyaṁ anāvikatvā.
